subject: Fastlane vendor recertification & micro-PO templates
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novaforge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fastlane vendor recertification & micro-PO templates

Hi Dylan,

We're approaching our July renewal and want to recertify Redwood on our vendor portal quickly. Procurement is open to a 'fastlane' onboarding refresh if we can provide: a shortened recert checklist, a standard PO template that supports micro-batches for the first quarter, and a signed term amendment that limits the initial commit.

Can you share a PO template and the recert checklist? Also, are you able to accept staggered micro-POs and a 30-day onboarding window? Our procurement lead Greg Liu is on copy when needed.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | NovaForge Technologies
attachments: none
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novaforge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fastlane vendor recertification & micro-PO templates

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answers:
- Yes, we can support micro-POs for the first 90 days and bridge them into a standard monthly PO once the commit stabilizes.
- We have a shortened recert checklist attached (redwood-recert-checklist.pdf) and a micro-PO template (fastlane-PO-template.xlsx) that includes a per-month cap field and invoicing cadence.
- For the term amendment, legal prefers a short SOW addendum; we can route a template for signature via DocuSign once you're comfortable with the PO fields.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached PO template and checklist and flag any missing fields by EOD Monday 13 May.
2) If okay, Ben (CC'd) will prepare an addendum for your legal team; we'll send via DocuSign and target signature within 7 business days.
3) Laura will request a NovaForge vendor invite to our procurement portal so you can upload required evidence.

I've attached both documents here. If Greg wants to hop on a short 20-minute call Monday morning to align, we can schedule.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: fastlane-PO-template.xlsx, redwood-recert-checklist.pdf

Thanks Dylan — reviewing now.

A couple of notes from procurement:
- Need a column for 'data residency' in the PO template (we run a mix of US/EU workloads).
- Can you confirm whether the micro-POs will be treated as pre-paid credits or invoiced on receipt? Prefer invoiced.

I've attached our executed NDA for your records (nova-signed-NDA.pdf). I'll flag any further changes by noon PST today.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Regards,
Elaine
